explanation: The statement is built entirely out of the library's own notions: `RelEffCartierDiv`, `RelEffCartierDiv.SupportedIn`, `sectionTwist`, `fibreAt`, `fibreModule`, `fibreIso`, `ChartHypotheses.nonempty_chartModule_iso`, and even `Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover` with `sectionsOf`/`.H0`/`.H1`. Grepping Mathlib for `RelEffCartierDiv`, `sectionTwist`, `fibreModule`, `fibreAt`, `fibreIso`, `TwoAffineOpenCover`, `exists_linearEquiv_sectionsOf_of_iso` and `exists_cover_chart_of_cover` yields nothing in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core. The single Mathlib-style ingredient (`Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.exists_linearEquiv_sectionsOf_of_iso`) is itself only a project-local theorem (imported from `Theorems.Thm_AlgebraicGeometry_Scheme_TwoAffineOpenCover_exists_linearEquiv_sectionsOf_of_iso`), and the target additionally needs `nonempty_chartModule_iso` and the fibre/section-twist machinery, so no one- or two-line derivation from a Mathlib declaration exists.
